column2: Listen up, darling. Let big sister walk you through how things work down here.
This little sector of ours is a delicate ecosystem, you see.
If someone takes too much without giving a single thing back...
The balance shatters, and the whole house of cards comes crashing down.
Play your cards right, and I'd love to do you some favors. In return...
You look out for my Lower Levels folks from time to time, deal?
Here, take my personal card. Keep it close.
Whenever you're in over your head, just give me a ring.
Well hello there, shopkeeper. It's been a while since I heard your voice.
Dr. Jackson was just pouting to me that you haven't dropped by his place either.
Just a gentle reminder, darling: whenever you need a hand, I'm right here.
Come closer. Take a look at the little treats I've put together for you.
Oh my... word on the street is you've hit a bit of a rough patch.
Charming local shops like yours are the beating heart of our community, you know.
Chin up, sweetheart. I'm throwing a few favors your way—on the house.
Here. Don't let me down now, okay?
Hey there, neighbor! Did you forget how to dial, or are you just playing hard to get?
Ring me up when you get a second. I don't bite... much.
My rolodex is packed with all sorts of delightful, capable folks.
Farming, purifying water, distilling fine moonshine... just say the word, and I'll make the introductions.
Just punch my number whenever you're ready, darling.
Ah... hello there.
I'm afraid I come with some rather heartbreaking news.
You were quite fond of Grandpa Cheng, weren't you?
Last night... the old man slipped away peacefully in his sleep.
He had a golden heart. A true cornerstone of our Lower Levels family.
He left something behind. I want you to have it, to remember him by.
Well, well, look at my star player! Good news travels fast.
This whole place is officially in your hands now. Congratulations! That's quite a feat down here.
Since you've proven yourself a truly capable merchant, I've got something exclusive for you.
Ever heard whispers about... "Hypertech"?
Miraculous stuff, darling. Far beyond anything the crude factories on this station could ever dream of making.
Even the high-and-mighty up in the Upper Levels would claw each other's eyes out for it.
I know a smuggler who dances in those shadows. I can make an introduction—for a rather handsome fee, of course.
But a fair warning from me first: every single step down that road will cost a pretty penny.
Once your nerves and your wallet are ready, give me a call.
[Browse Ms. Wild's Services]
Hello, this is Ms. Wild's private office...
How may we be of service to you today, dear?
Here is what we can arrange for you at the moment.
Ahem... Citizen, attention! This is Officer Lun from the Security Department!
I am currently on a very serious, top-priority sector patrol...!
The thing is... um... I left my lunchbox at home in a rush... Do you have anything edible here? whimpers
Wah, a lifesaver! I-I'll accept this under official requisition orders...!
Dummy! My stomach is growling here, that's not something you can eat...!
nom nom... Hmph, good citizen. I'll let your minor infractions slide today!
Help, somebody help meee! Boss! Give me some neural painkillers or whatever you've got, right now!
It hurts so bad...! Some jerk in a grey jumpsuit jumped me in the alley...!
I don't care if it's black-market contraband! Just shoot me with the strongest dose you have, please... it hurts so much...!
Shh... this is completely off the books! Internal Affairs can NEVER find out about this, got it...?!
Yes... that's it... Th-Thank you so much, sniff...
Wah! Not that! I'm seeing stars here, give me something that stops the pain!
Eep! Who cares if it's unregistered contraband, as long as it works! Give it here!
sniff... Ahhh... I think the feeling is coming back... I almost became a line-of-duty casualty, geez...!
Um... Boss... I, uh, "accidentally" stumbled across some gear during patrol...
A-Are you buying? C'mon, give a girl a decent price, we're buddies, right...?
Yay! D-Deal! Remember, you never got this from me, okay?!
Eh? Wait... wait a sec! What are you guys doing here?!
Hey! That's the scumbag who ambushed Officer Lun!
Grab him! Don't let him get away!
Wahhh?! This is the absolute worst!
Heheh, salute! See that? Officer Lun is officially back on duty, fully recovered!
That was just a little paid vacation in the Medbay, that's all... I totally didn't cry for my mommy!
Don't panic, don't panic! This is just a completely normal routine check-in.
Since I'm already here... could you slip me some of those heavy-duty painkillers?
The extra-strength kind, please... The stitches still sting sometimes, you know...
Just for the record! It's purely for emergency reserves! I am definitely not getting dependent on them, okay?!
Hehe, deal! Tucked safely inside my sleeves where nobody can see~
Wah, thanks a million... High-grade neural injectors like this cost a fortune. You're actually really sweet...!
No, no, no! I asked for neuro-blocker painkillers! What did you just hand me?!
S-Synaprest?! Do you... do you think I've got a substance problem?! I don't!
And even if I did... with my pathetic patrol stipend, I could never afford this stuff anyway, sniff...
Works for me! Quick, shove it up my sleeve... I'll take it!
Mmhmm, looks legit! Now I can finally finish patrol without wincing!
Shh—hey! Keep it down, little boss, it's your absolute lucky day!
Requisition just authorized the release of some... cough, 'surplus tactical assets'!
Well? I smuggled them straight here just for you. Interested?
But pinky promise first! Strictly confidential between us, not a peep to anyone!
If you're a pal and take the whole batch, I'm authorized to give you 33% off! Pretty sweet deal, huh!
Splendid! You're a lifesaver... the ledger might actually balance now!
Waaah?! W-Wait! Why are Internal Affairs here...?!
Officer Lun? What in the world are you doing skulking around that counter?
Found them! This is the missing gear flagged from the Armory!
W-Wait, I can explain! I just brought them out for anti-rust maintenance... it wasn't black-marketing, I swear!
Come quietly, Officer Lun. You know what happens if you resist the inspectorate.
Ahem! Freeze! S-Surprise inspection! Routine security check!
Open up the safe, right now! No stalling, I can be very tough if I have to!
Hmph! Caught red-handed! Unregistered controlled neuro-stims detected. Confiscating them this instant!
Don't you pout at me! You should be grateful I didn't slap cuffs on you and drag you to the station!
sighs in deep relief... Phew, all clear. You're clean... gosh, that was nerve-wracking.
Eh...? C-Chief?
Officer Lun. What on earth are you doing here instead of filing reports at the precinct?
I-I was just... uh... conducting a highly rigorous surprise inspection...!
You were assigned to desk duty last week. You have zero authority to conduct field frisks.
Drop the act. We already know your little game of skimming seized goods.
Impersonating field patrol and abusing police authority. You are under arrest.
Attention! Citizen, please note: I am Officer Lun from the Security Department!
Ahem... attached to the Tactical Security Enforcement Division!
Pursuant to standard municipal security protocol, section 404...
Listen closely: there is a red emergency alarm button installed under your counter.
Here, keep this newly updated wanted roster pinned somewhere visible!
If any of these dangerous felons dare set foot inside your store...
Do NOT, under any circumstances, listen to a single word they say!
Tap that alarm button and alert us before they leave the counter!
The Security strike squad... and me, will arrive to take care of the rest!
But remember! Only trigger the alarm if you are absolutely positive it's them!
If you file a false report and make me rush here for nothing... you will be heavily fined!
Um... anyway, have a secure and safe shift. Stay out of trouble!
Phew, it's Officer Lun back on your sector!
Hey, have you actually been checking the faces on that Wanted list?
High command just issued new directives, so listen up carefully.
Report all sellers carrying mid-level Contraband, or higher, without hesitation!
Low-level contraband peddlers aren't worth the paperwork or our time.
Your merchant reputation out on the street might take a hit, sure...
But we will reward you handsomely based on the volume of contraband we seize!
Got that? Keep your eyes peeled, and have a secure shift!
Phew... Scoured through everything and found nothing illegal. You're clear!
Ahem! Th-Thank you for cooperating with the Security Department, citizen!
[Accept Inspection.]
[Offer Bribe. ({0} Credits)]
Huh? Hold on, there are low-grade contraband components hidden here!
Mmh... Considering you're usually well-behaved, I'll let you off with just a verbal warning this time!
Don't you dare let me see this again, understood?! I mean it!
Open your cargo bay completely and step back behind the line!
Wah! Caught red-handed! You're harboring unregistered contraband!
Pursuant to security codes, you are fined {0} Credits!
I don't have enough Credits...
Wh-What?! Refusal to pay means open defiance—you're under arrest!
All these illegal supplies are officially confiscated!
And you must pay the {0} Credits fine right here on the spot! Instantly!
[Pays the fine]
Hmph, good attitude at least... Thank you for your cooperation!
Phew... Security advisory update! Confirmation received that all rogue augs in this sector have been terminated!
Special commendation for your bravery during the crisis... Ahem, thank you very much for your cooperation!
Threat level cleared. You won't be needing this shotgun anymore, time to surrender it to armory.
Salute! I'm procuring emergency operational supplies on behalf of the Security Department.
The folks on field duty are starving and battered—we urgently need rations and trauma medical kits!
Um... our municipal budget is pretty much burnt out, but voluntary citizen donations are super, duper welcome!
Radio static crackles with frantic reprimands
Waaah... What gives?! All the crime logs we painstakingly gathered on you just vanished from the database?!
Wh-What kind of cyber wizard did you hire as backup?! Don't get smug, we'll catch you red-handed one day!
Straighten up, citizen! Security has acquired indisputable evidence of your multiple violations!
Detailed infractions include: {0}!
Under municipal penal code, you must immediately settle a fine of {0} Credits!
Refuse and I'll personally cuff you straight to the holding cells!
[Pay The Fine ({0} Credits)]
Hmph, good that you paid! Don't cause any more headaches for my patrol, understood?!
[Don't Pay The Fine]
Wah! You dare openly defy orders?! Th-Then you are under arrest right this second!
You have the right to remain silent! Anything you say will go straight into my patrol log against you!
Freeze! Hands behind your head! You are under arrest!
Charges filed: {0}!
Ugh... You've really crossed the line this time. You'll be locked away in the brig for ages...
You have the right to remain silent... Plead your case to the magistrate droids!
D-Draw weapons! Hands in the air! Freeze! You are under arrest by High Security Command!
Classified as maximum-tier felony: {0}!
Your actions have triggered lethal protocols... You will be executed on the spot!
Um... Citizen. In light of your recent string of dangerous violations...
Official command directives have arrived: your merchant permit is hereby revoked!
sniff... Have a safe shift... please stop getting into trouble.
Huh? Under the counter... there really is unapproved contraband tucked away!
Per safety regulations, these hazards are officially tagged and seized!
Have a secure shift, and don't go stashing illegal gear next time!
stares intensely—The serial codes don't match, these are flagged stolen goods!
Waaah! H-How can you display open contraband right on the counter like that?!
Step back! Keep your hands off the counter, I'm initiating a full-store sweep!
Eep! Isn't that the stolen item flagged in yesterday's bulletin?! You left it right in plain sight!
Mmh...! swiftly sweeps the credits into her oversized sleeve... I-I guess my vision was a bit blurry this time...!
Wh-What is this?! This is definitely not registered civilian stock!
Red-handed! You are under arrest for illegal possession of contraband!
Sniff, possessing this alone is more than enough reason for me to cuff you to the cells!
But... the Commander personally radioed down telling me to look away... Just who is backing you up up there?
Hmph, don't you dare count on getting this lucky on my next patrol!
Shh! Keep your voice down... Keep a low profile when running this shop, will you!
High command is only tolerating this for now, it doesn't make it legal! You dummy!
Waaah! Are you insane?! Why would you show something this blatantly illegal to a patrol cop?!
Salute! Citizen, clearance granted. You are authorized to purchase excess stock from our supply division.
Here's a batch of decommissioned patrol gear and surplus hardware.
If you take the entire crate off our hands, I can sign off on a 15% discount for you!
Wah! I just stepped inside! Isn't that straight-up illegal contraband on your counter?!
Hey, hey, hey! My eyes aren't blind! That's clearly tagged stolen property on your counter!
glare—! How dare you openly display black-market contraband inside a display case?!
Waaah! In broad daylight?! Your display case is loaded with hot, stolen merchandise!
That includes the tactical shotgun mounted behind your counter... Hand it over, right now!
Phew... Checked the system, your firearms permit still covers the shotgun. Keep it for self-defense!
Waaah, damn it all! How did that rogue aug slip past our perimeter again?!
Listen closely! If you catch so much as a glimpse of that rogue aug again...
Don't hesitate! Do not hesitate for a second—shoot it on sight!
bzzzt— Eep! They... the augs' neural feedback just hacked our tactical comms!
Anyway... barricade your door and stay vigilant! Please, stay safe out there!
pant, pant... We got your emergency distress call! Officer Lun on the scene!
Stand back... Let me scan this suspected aug target first.
...Mmh... gulps nervously...
Phew... Cybernetic core disabled. Scans confirm this was definitely a rogue aug!
Splendid shot! Nice marksmanship! You just saved our patrol squad a ton of trouble!
Alright, alright, our security division will haul this chassis away for disposal!
Waaahhh! B-Boss?! Are you crazy?! What on earth have you done?!
He doesn't have a single cybernetic implant! You... you just killed an innocent living person! Waaah!
Waaah, this is terrible... huge disaster! I have to patch this into headquarters right now!
Tactical radio crackles with frantic, stern dispatch chatter
sniff... Not again... Command just ordered a blackout on this incident? Just which top brass do you have in your pocket?!
Y-You got lucky this time... Security is forcibly sweeping this under the rug!
Engrave this into your skull! That shotgun is strictly for shooting augs, understood?!
Sniff... Nobody can bail you out now. Security is officially booking you for reckless manslaughter!
[Accept Inspection]
[Offer Bribe ({0} Credit)]/
Um... Seeing as the sector bio-hazard isn't fully cleared, you can hold onto that shotgun for now...
We can't afford to miss a single opportunity to wipe out those augs! If you spot one, fire!
Yo, Boss. Name's Sawyer—remember the face, 'cause I run these streets.
Straight to the point... You know Auntie Cheng around the corner, right?
Back when I was a ragged gutter rat scrounging for scraps... Auntie Cheng took me in and fed me hot meals.
If it weren't for her, my bones would've been rotting in the undercity scrap heaps years ago.
Tsk... but my crew tells me she's been rolling up the storefront later and later every day, looking fragile as hell...
Half the shelves are completely wiped clean, yet she's still bleeding credits feeding stray orphans!
Dammit... I... tsk, fine! The truth is, I'm worried sick about her!
You're set up close to her. Keep an eye on her for me, got it?! If she's short on meds or food... you holler at me immediately!
Ta-daaa! Yahoo, Boss! That's right, it is I, Georgio!
Heheh, yes, *that* very same legendary Georgio!
The GREATEST scavenger princess in all of the Lower Levels!
You're super lucky today! Georgio has brought you her latest, most magnificent find!
Behold! Gaze upon relics from an ancient, forgotten alien civilization...!
Bwahaha! A true connoisseur! Georgio knew you had remarkable taste!
Until my next cosmic discovery, my dear friend! See ya!
Yahoo! Georgio is back and shining brighter than ever!
You remember this dashing face, right, my friend?
Today, Georgio brings you an epoch-making invention crafted entirely by her own genius hands...!
Georgio generously decided to grant you the honor of being the very first merchant to stock it!
Hold your breath... and gaze upon... the Water of Tomorrow! Ta-daaa!
Whaaa?! Wait! What did Georgio do wrong?! My ahoge is shaking in fear!
Keep it down, you little scrap rat! Stop squawking, you're coming with us.
The great Georgio has triumphantly returned!
Georgio put her life on the line to score 100% genuine, authentic Heminwai cigarettes!
Whaddya say? Care to buy a pack or two, boss?
Heheh, for my favorite shopkeeper pal, Georgio gives you the ultimate bestie discount!
Yes, yes! Woohoo! Georgio loves doing business with you!
Off Georgio goes! Catch you later, my dear friend!
Eep! Let go of Georgio! Georgio is completely innocent and pure!
Save the theatrics, little scrap girl. You're coming with us.
Guess who's back in town~?
That's right! It's your energetic Georgio once again!
Georgio recently braved laser turrets and sneaked all the way into the Upper Levels for some epic scavenging!
There's actually scrap worth scavenging in the Upper Levels?
Heheh, just for you, my pal? Georgio is slashing 25% off everything from the Upper Levels!
Bwahaha! Splendid! Partnering with Georgio is the best decision you've ever made!
Bye-bye, my faithful friend!
Just wait and see! More boundless riches Georgio shall bring you next time!
Oh no no no, not the badges again! Why is Georgio always getting busted?!
Hey! There's that wild girl who sneaked into the Upper Levels luxury bathhouse vents to fish for spare parts!
Stop squirming, girl. You're coming with us to the precinct.
Whew! Long time no see, my fine shopkeeper!
The great wasteland pioneer Georgio has returned once more!
Open your eyes wide and gaze upon the magnificent loot Georgio brought for you!
These slick circuits, this sexy mechanical design... Fascinating stuff, don'tcha think?!
Where on earth did you even dig this out from...?
Heheh! A top-tier scavenger princess NEVER reveals her secret honey holes!
Enough chitchat! You want this glorious loot or not? Give Georgio a straight answer!
Georgio can always find another big-shot buyer on the street, you know...
Aha! Georgio knew you couldn't resist this mechanical romance! Sold!
Until next time, my most generous friend!
Save up plenty of shiny Credits and eagerly await Georgio's next legendary haul!
Wahhh?! What gives?! Boss, did you actually snitch on sweet, innocent Georgio?!
Caught you red-handed, little thief! Hands up, you're under arrest!
How on earth do you keep slithering through the air ducts into our evidence room?!
Heheh, Georgio is the most loyal best friend in the entire universe, no?
Georgio saw you accidentally drop your precious stuff at the Dumping Grounds last night...
Did Georgio keep it for scrap? Nope! Georgio hauled it all the way back for you!
Heheh, no need to burst into happy tears—no need to be modest with Georgio!
Safe and sound, returned to its rightful owner, my friend!
Um... the truth is... Georgio desperately needs a tiny favor from you...
Georgio is building an awesome spaceship! To scavenge across the entire galaxy...!
The hull is basically finished, but... Georgio completely ran out of Credits, sniff...
Would you be an angel and fund Georgio's cosmic dream, my dear friend? Pretty please!
Waaah?! For real?! That was so easy! You're actually lending it to Georgio?!
Here, take this! Georgio won't need worldly trinkets where she's headed anyway...!
Every single Credit will be paid back with massive interest! Georgio swears on her ahoge!
Farewell for now, my friend! We shall meet again among the stars!
Waaaah! So much?! Are you super sure?! Thank you, thank you! Georgio is gonna cry!
Here, take Georgio's prized heirloom! Georgio won't be needing it past the stratosphere...!
Sniff... I see... That's totally fine, my friend! No hard feelings!
Georgio is the toughest scavenger girl around! She'll dig up every last alloy plate with her bare hands!
Take good care of yourself, my dear friend!
Eeeeek! Don't cuff Georgio! Please officers, have mercy on poor Georgio! Waaah!
Shut it! You have the right to remain silent.
Stop kicking and come with us to the holding cells!
Hahaha! That's right! Rub your eyes, citizen, you are not dreaming!
Georgio, the Queen of Scavengers, has returned triumphant from the stars!
Feast your eyes! Here are your Credits, paid back in full with massive interest!
Whew! Debt settled! Now Georgio must return to the bridge of her starship...
After all—the vast junk piles of the cosmos won't scavenge themselves! Yahoo!
[Offer {0} Credits]
[Decline]
Yahoo, pal! Today is your absolute lucky day!
Georgio just crafted herself a brand new mega backpack, so this trusty old one has to find a new home!
Giving you a jaw-dropping mega discount, just because it's you!
Hiya! My favorite big-shot boss, Georgio is here to say hi!
As everyone knows, Georgio is objectively the greatest scavenger to ever walk these scrap heaps!
So as the reigning champ, why shouldn't Georgio lend a helping hand to fellow scavengers?
Starting now, Georgio is offering her elite assistance at the Dumping Ground!
Want a taste of greatness? Only {0} Credits for {1} full nights of Georgio's protection!
[Accept ({0} Credits)]
Yahoo! Excellent! Georgio will meet you at the Dumping Ground rendezvous tonight!
Puff up your chest! Nobody gets hurt when Georgio is on watch!
No sweat, my pal! We're still besties. Hit Georgio up whenever you change your mind!
Bestie! Huge news! Georgio is launching an incredible new business venture!
Georgio's scavenging luck has always been off the charts, so why not bottle up some of that fortune?
Gaze upon this miracle—Liquid Luck! First bottle's completely on the house!
Hiya, friend! Tell me, tell me—how did you like Georgio's patented Liquid Luck?
Georgio has only one final batch left! Grab it before it vanishes forever!
Shh—friend! Keep it down. Georgio has something super confidential to hand you.
Georgio stumbled across a runaway black-haired girl hiding in the shadows of the Dumping Ground.
With teary eyes, she begged Georgio to bring you this letter. Georgio did NOT peek! Well... maybe just a tiny peek!
[Call in a favor ({0} Lower Levels rep+)]
Whoa! The Lower Levels street folks hold you in such high regard?! Say no more, Georgio's on it!
That poor girl is starving half to death out there, right? Georgio just happens to have a crate of Nutrifruits!
For just {0} Credits, Georgio will sneak over and deliver them for you. You don't have to carry a single bite!
Hmm... Georgio heard Security is breathing down your neck, so you can't head out to the Dumping Ground lately, right?
Turn that frown upside down! Georgio happens to have a full crate of high-calorie Nutrifruits tucked away!
For just {0} Credits, Georgio will run the gauntlet and feed her. Otherwise, Georgio really fears she won't survive the night...
Yahoo! With these Nutrifruits, that poor girl will eat like a princess tonight!
A friend of yours is a lifetime friend of the great Georgio!
No worries, my friend! Georgio trusts you'll head out to the ruins and feed her yourself!
*sigh*... Georgio understands. Let's pray the poor girl manages to scrounge up some scraps on her own...
Hmph... so this rusty shack packed with junk is what you gutter-dwellers call a "shop"?
Quite the eye-opener. I suppose it might seem decent if you've never set foot in a proper Upper Level boutique.
Hey, you behind the counter! Until I'm cleared to return to the Upper Levels, I require some proper food.
It won't be long until those incompetent security droids realize what a colossal mistake they've made!
They dared arrest my mother for "embezzlement"! She manages the single largest hydroponics biosphere on this entire station!
Absolutely absurd! Half the ungrateful wretches on this station only have food on their tables because of her!
Ahem... so what edible goods do you have? Fresh only! I won't stomach a bland, monotonous menu.
I still can't believe it... I'm actually stranded in this filthy, damp nightmare!
Not a whisper from Mother, and the elevator checkpoints keep turning me away cold...
Why me?! What did I ever do to deserve this sheer injustice?!
Ugh, I hate this place! Everything reeks of burnt engine oil. It's so wildly unfair!
*scoffs with a miserable sigh*... Hey. Do you stock any basic toiletries or household goods?
*bites lip*... Looks like I'll be forced to endure this slum for a while longer.
I managed to secure a passable little room across from the Commissary...
It's dreadfully cramped, but at least... at least it doesn't reek of raw sewage.
I honestly can't fathom how anyone could endure an entire lifetime trapped in such squalor...
Hey... it's me again.
Mmh... my remaining credits are running dangerously low.
When the security guards raided our estate, they barely let me pack a single suitcase...
If only... if only I can find a way back up to the Upper Levels...
I could march straight to the tribunal, expose the truth, and clear our family name!
And then... everything can return to how it was. Polite, dignified, and peaceful.
And I will NEVER have to pinch my nose and chew on dry, tasteless Nutrifruit again...!
Cough... anyway! I brought some personal jewelry and keepsakes. Name a decent price for them.
I... I really can't take this anymore...
*eyes reddening* A thief broke in last night... they took the last scraps of jewelry and rations I had!
I don't know... I honestly don't know what to do anymore...
I'll be trapped down here forever, and Mother will rot away in some deep-space cell...
I... I can barely believe I'm humiliating myself like this...
But please... could you spare me something to eat?
Even stale hardtack or scraps... anything edible, please...!
*sniff*... Thank you so much... Eleanor will never, ever forget this kindness.
Hey! Look, Boss—this lady didn't stay down for long!
After I broke down in tears in front of you last time...
I realized that crying changes nothing. Life moves forward whether I like it or not.
I have to pull myself together and find the proof to clear her name with my own hands!
But first, I need steady income to survive and fund my search.
So... I decided to roll up my sleeves and scavenge the Dumping Grounds!
My neighbor gave me an intensive crash course on scrap-sorting last night.
It's filthy down here, but I must admit... the people here share a genuine warmth.
Here! Don't underestimate a lady's grit. Take a look at my morning haul!
I'm completely penniless...
Mother's trial is over. Those bribed judges found her guilty...!
Besides... hmph, I'm actually getting used to the stench of stale grease down here.
Mother was definitely framed by some high-ranking scoundrel in the Upper Levels!
Hello there. You're acquainted with young Eleanor, aren't you? I'm her... "uncle."
The family put together a little care package for her. Only the finest luxuries from the Upper Levels.
Trouble is, she moves around too much. I can't seem to track her down.
When she drops by next, could you hand this crate directly to her?
Make sure it's in her hands. Not yours. Hers. Understood?
And if anyone asks around... you never laid eyes on me.
Oh, and don't involve Security. This is strictly family business.
Security check. Shopkeeper, you reported a stolen item here?
Hey! You've got it wrong! I didn't steal this, I have the receipt right here!
If you didn't steal it, why did you flag this exact serial number as stolen thirty minutes ago?
Uh... dammit...
Framing civilians and filing false theft reports is a felony. Quiet down and march!
Freeze! Drop that crate! This cargo was officially reported stolen from the Upper Levels!
Wh-What?! This isn't mine! I've never even seen it before!
Embezzling mother, fencing daughter. Like mother, like daughter. Cuff her!
I've been framed! Please! Someone set me up! Shopkeeper, tell them! Please!
Hey, Boss. I've been thinking hard about our next move regarding Mother's case.
I swear on our family honor, someone powerful in the Upper Levels orchestrated this!
I'm blacklisted from the elevators, but a discreet private investigator could sneak up and snoop around.
But hiring a reputable, tight-lipped investigator costs at least {0} Credits.
So I'll keep digging through the Dumping Grounds and bringing you everything I salvage.
Give me a fair price, okay? Every single credit brings me one step closer to clearing her.
Thank you so much! Only {0} more Credits to reach the retainer fee!
*pants*... wiping off soot, I'm back again!
Just {0} more Credits until I can finally hire that investigator!
Look, here's the best loot I dug up from the ruins today!
Splendid! With this transaction, I finally have enough credits for the retainer!
Thank you for standing by me through all this. I will unmask whoever did this to my mother!
*Tell her about the suspicious man claiming to be her uncle and the crate*
My uncle?! What kind of sick joke is that? I'm an only child, Mother has no brothers!
He left a crate specifically addressed to me... and pre-flagged it as stolen in the system?!
I see their game... They wanted me cuffed red-handed! Thrown into prison just like Mother!
My hands are shaking... I... I need a moment to collect my thoughts.
But your quick wits saved my life. Please, take this. It's the last heirloom I have from home.
I'll come back once I've cleared my head and figured out our countermove.
Shh... lock the door! The investigator risked his neck and sneaked something monumental down!
A military-grade encrypted data drive, hidden deep inside a secret panel in Mother's old lab.
